title: Multifunctional Engineered Metal–Organic Frameworks as Targeted Protein Degraders for Augmenting Cancer Therapy via Hexokinase 2 Degradation and Provoking Cuproptosis
creator: Shasha Li, Runjie Liu, Qixuan Zhang, Jiahui Sun, Hao Hao, Chenhao Yao, Li Yan, Dan Yang, Dechun Liu
description: Cuproptosis, a newly identified form of copper-dependent programmed cell death, has emerged as a potential therapeutic strategy for cancer treatment. However, its antitumor efficacy was strictly limited by dysregulated glycolytic metabolism of tumor cells. Herein, we proposed multifunctional copper-based nano-PROTACs (CHNDs) to degrade hexokinase 2 (HK-2) and amplify cuproptosis for cancer therapy via dual mitochondrial energy depletion.

title: Data-driven optimisation of multi-agency river water quality monitoring networks under high anthropogenic pressure
creator: Hugo Pimentel Tavares, Lucas Lamin de Souza Silva, Nilo Antônio de Souza Sampaio, Carin von Mühlen
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Integrating heterogeneous water quality data from multiple monitoring agencies into a single reproducible analytical pipeline remains an unsolved challenge in environmental science. We present the Optimised Water Quality Monitoring Framework (OWQMF), an open-source four-block pipeline that harmonises multi-source monitoring data, computes dual water quality indices with objectively derived weights using a game-theory ensemble of three objective weighting methods, produces gradient-boosting ensemble forecasts with walk-forward cross-validation, and selects the best forecasting model through multi-criteria consensus with Adaptive Conformal Prediction coverage guarantees (≥ ≥90%).

title: Online exposure to marriage information and marriage expectations of Generation Z in China: The roles of marriage value and relative information exposure
creator: Zhikang Wang, Hua Yang, Yujie Jiang
description: PurposeThe marriage expectations of Generation Z youth in China, the main force of marriage currently and over the next decade, are declining. In this study, several moderated mediation models were constructed to explain the effects of online exposure to marriage information on the marriage expectations of Gen Z from an information processing perspective.

title: A phylogeny for genus Capra based on extensive sampling of wild populations
creator: Steve Jordan, Saeid Naderi, Hamid-Reza Rezaei, Gordon Luikart
description: Among the most economically and ecologically important taxa are those with wild and domestic counterparts, such as the true goats (genus Capra), that are distributed and used by humans world-wide. Such taxa often played roles in the spread of pastoralism, farming, and modern societies.

title: Comparative evaluation and agreement between ICDAS and UniViSS caries detection systems among toddlers and preschoolers
creator: K.C. Vignesh, Gnanasekaran Felsypremila, S. Ishvarya, P. Anitha, Haridoss Selvakumar, P.C. Arthi
description: ObjectivesTo compare the agreement and concordance between ICDAS and UniViSS caries detection systems among toddlers and preschoolers.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 281 children aged 2–6 years at a tertiary care hospital in South India. All primary molars were examined using both systems and converted to binary format (caries present vs.

title: Effects of game-based learning and flipped classroom strategies on performance and reasoning in patient safety education for surgical nursing students
creator: Mohadesehsadat Mehrdad, Sara Jambarsang, Hosseinali Sadeghian, Fatemeh Jabinian, Fatemeh Keshmiri
description: IntroductionThe present study aimed to assess the effect of game-based learning (GBL) on surgical nursing students’ performance and reasoning skills in the management of patient safety incidents in surgical units compared to the flipped classroom method.MethodThis quasi-experimental study was conducted at Shahid Sadoughi University of Medical Sciences in 2023–2024.

title: Reprocessable carbon fiber composites via disulfide-exchange epoxy vitrimers: experimental and molecular simulation insights
creator: Harsh Sharma, Nehal Kaushik, Songchang Liu, Rajkamal Anand, Nanda Gopal Sahoo, Gun Jin Yun, Sravendra Rana
description: The growing demand for carbon fiber-reinforced polymer (CFRP) composites in high-performance sectors such as wind energy and automotive underscores the urgent need for recyclable alternatives to traditional thermoset systems. Although disulfide-based epoxy vitrimers have shown promise for reprocessability, a clear correlation between dynamic bond exchange kinetics, network structure, and composite-level mechanical performance remains insufficiently understood.

title: Patients’ satisfaction after orthognathic surgery among the Saudi population in the Eastern Province: A cross-sectional study
creator: Basma AlMaghlouth, Abdullah Alshammari, Zaher Shamma, Laila Hassan Alwusaybie, Abdulrahman Khattar, Intisar A Siddiqui
description: PurposeThis study evaluated changes in patient-reported functional, aesthetic, and psychosocial outcomes before and after orthognathic surgery and assessed overall satisfaction among patients treated in the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia.MethodsA retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted among 100 patients who underwent orthognathic surgery at Dammam Medical Complex, Saudi Arabia.

title: Automating the segmentation, date extraction, and classification of multi-report PDFs in outside medical records using optical character recognition and generative artificial intelligence
creator: Shivam Damani, Benjamin Hinton, Tanner Hunt, Nicholas Lawrence, Kurt Miller, Melinda Rice, Kevin Peterson, Sarah McLaughlin, Alexander Ryu
description: ObjectivesPatients referred for specialized care often arrive with outside medical records (OMRs) compiled into multi-report PDFs that include imaging, pathology, and clinical notes in unstructured formats. Reviewing these records is time consuming and mentally taxing, increasing the risk of delayed care, clinician frustration, and missed information affecting quality of care.

title: Pattern of road traffic accidents in Nepal: A cross-sectional record review
creator: Minani Gurung, Olita Shilpakar, Lisasha Poudel, Bipsana Shrestha, Aakriti Poudel, Tai Anjuk Lama, Niranjan Panta, Bibek Giri
description: BackgroundRoad traffic accidents (RTAs) are a leading cause of mortality and disability in Nepal. Despite the scale of the problem, comprehensive province-level analyses covering recent years remain limited. This study describes the pattern of RTAs across all seven provinces of Nepal over four fiscal years.

title: Extended Directed Fuzzy Social Network Analysis: A framework and application to curriculum networks in Chinese vocational education
creator: Borui Zuo, Keqi Shang, Jie Zhang, Manyu Peng, Zhiming Zhu
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Due to the differences in node types and the diversity of network relationships, Fuzzy Social Network Analysis (FSNA) needs to specifically address the issues of network heterogeneity and relationship ambiguity. To address this challenge, we propose a new analytical framework called Extended Directed Fuzzy Social Network Analysis Framework (EFDSNAF), which establishes the Typical Connections to assist in evaluating the fuzzy network.

title: Targeting TPX2-dependent lineage plasticity by CDK4/6 inhibition reverses therapy resistance in neuroendocrine bladder carcinoma
creator: Zehua Chen, Shengmeng Peng, Shi Fu, Shizhi Lin, Yiwen Su, Xinxin He, Yangjie Zhang, Junlin Lu, Sen Liu, Hengji Zhan, Jianmei Zhong, Baolin Ye, Chengjunyu Zhang, Chu Liu, Bolin Pan, Haonan Dong, Hongqiong Li, Xinni Ye, Jun Wang, Siting Chen, Baoqing He, Jingdie Wu, Hui Li, Qiang Zhang, Haifeng Wang,
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryNeuroendocrine bladder carcinoma (NEBC) is an aggressive and therapy-resistant cancer with poor prognosis. Although lineage plasticity drives urothelial-to-neuroendocrine transdifferentiation, intermediate states remain poorly characterized. Through transcriptomic profiling of public datasets, we define a lineage plasticity-associated signature in bladder cancer. We analyze 64,756 in-house and 201,720 public single-cell transcriptomes from NEBC and urothelial carcinoma (UC), identifying TPX2high bladder cancer cell subpopulation with increased lineage plasticity, supported by multi-cohort histological validation. TPX2high cells lack canonical neuroendocrine markers and are associated with adverse clinical outcomes.

title: Resistance to a Novel Clinical Trial Design for Multicancer Detection Tests: Experimental Investigation of Ambiguity Aversion
creator: Jacob A Rohde, Jackelyn B Payne, Richard P Moser, William M P Klein, Philip E Castle, Paul K J Han
description: Background:Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are needed to evaluate multicancer detection (MCD) tests. A novel “intended-effect” RCT design in which control group participants receive MCD testing but results remain undisclosed can increase statistical efficiency. Prospective participants may find this design unacceptable due to ambiguity aversion introduced by the existence of undisclosed but theoretically knowable test results.

title: Bed nucleus of the stria terminalis-nucleus accumbens stimulation for depression: A randomized, double-blind, crossover trial
creator: Yijie Lai, Yingying Zhang, Yuhan Wang, Linbin Wang, Luling Dai, Kuanghao Ye, Xin Lv, Fengting Wang, Jinrong Zhang, Yijie Zhao, Kejia Hu, Peng Huang, Xiaoxiao Zhang, Xian Qiu, Yixin Pan, Wei Liu, Qimin Liu, Chencheng Zhang, Yiru Fang, Zheng Ye, Ti-Fei Yuan, Dianyou Li, Ninfei Li, Andres M. Lozano, Va

To assess the efficacy of DBS of the bed nucleus of the stria terminalis (BNST) and nucleus accumbens (NAc) for TRD, we conduct a randomized, double-blind, crossover trial after an open-label optimization stage.

title: The state of vestibular neurology: Diagnostic challenges and emerging opportunities
creator: Diego Kaski, Richard Ibitoye
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Vestibular neurology has undergone substantial evolution over the past two decades, driven by advances in bedside diagnostics, neuroimaging, computational neuroscience, and therapeutics. Despite this progress, dizziness and vertigo remain among the most common yet diagnostically challenging neurological complaints. This narrative review examines the current state of vestibular neurology, focusing on key clinical syndromes, ongoing diagnostic controversies, and emerging opportunities for innovation.

title: Antibody response to tetanus, diphtheria, poliomyelitis, hepatitis B, and H. influenzae b vaccines in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant adult recipients: A multicenter trial
creator: Olivier Epaulard, Martin Carré, Eric Hermet, Violaine Corbin, Emmanuelle Tavernier, Elisabeth Botelho-Nevers, Etienne Daguindau, Anne-Sophie Brunel, Pierre-Simon Rohrlich, Karine Risso, Salomé Gallet, Nicolas Gonnet, Saber Touati, Marc Manceau, Anne Thiebault, Ray Borrow, Ray Borrow, Ray Borrow, Ray

We therefore aimed to assess the immune response in adult allogeneic HSCT recipients vaccinated against tetanus, diphtheria, poliomyelitis, hepatitis B, and H. influenzae b.MethodWe conducted a multicenter prospective study.

title: A harmless-to-harmful switchable and spatiotemporally activated nano-CRISPR hierarchically amplifies ferroptosis in melanoma
creator: Chunqing Ou, Xianzhou Huang, Dongxue Huang, Rui Luo, Ruhan Chen, Xinchao Li, Xinyue Wu, Qinjie Wu, Changyang Gong
description: SummaryFerroptosis therapy faces challenges due to low lipid peroxide (LPO) levels. Herein, we develop a harmless-to-harmful switchable and spatiotemporally activated nano-CRISPR system (termed ARCHER) that sequentially amplifies ferroptosis sensitivity, iron ion levels, and reactive oxygen species (ROS) to amplify ferroptosis therapy efficiency. ARCHER targets cancer cells and releases CRISPR-Cas9 and Ce6Fe(III)Cl in response to hyaluronidase and tumor acidity.

title: Welcoming new Editors to Disease Models & Mechanisms
creator: Kirsty Hooper
description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Summary: DMM broadens its editorial expertise by welcoming two new Editors to our team: Satdarshan (Paul) Singh Monga and Shinya Yamamoto. Satdarshan (Paul) Singh Monga (left) and Shinya Yamamoto (right)

At the heart of Disease Models & Mechanisms (DMM) is a dedicated team of research-active Editors who work to maintain our high standards in publishing cutting-edge disease-focused research, steer the direction of the journal within dynamic research ecosystems and strengthen our connections with numerous research communities.

Serum biochemistry analysis revealed increased aspartate aminotransferase, alanine transaminase, ammonia (226 μg/dL), and fasting total bile acids (130 μmol/L).

creator: Octave Cannac, Vanessa Pauly, Christine Zandotti, Léa Luciani, Paul-Rémi Petit, Xavier de Lamballerie, Rémi Charrel, Laurent Papazian, Damien Barrau, Geoffray Agard, Sami Hraiech, Glenda Canderan, Glenda Canderan, Glenda Canderan, Glenda Canderan

title: Protocol for culture, drug treatment, and dissociation of patient-derived 3D ovarian cancer microspheroids for flow cytometry
creator: Mariam Haffa, Karolina Juhani, Greta Gudoityte, Rita Hutyra-Gram Ötvös, Emelie Wallin, Olli-Pekka Kallioniemi, Josefin Fernebro, Ulrika Joneborg, Brinton Seashore-Ludlow
description: SummarySingle-cell technologies provide insights into tumor heterogeneity and treatment response. Here, we present a protocol to culture patient-derived ovarian tumor cells as 3D microspheroids. We describe steps for preparing multi-well dishes and isolating ovarian tumor cells for spheroid generation and culture. We then detail procedures for drug treatment, recovery, and dissociation of spheroids followed by single-cell analysis via flow cytometry.

A structured process for adult RSV disease decision-making can guide public health epidemiology and planning.

Here, we show that IL-7 therapy preferentially expands these stem-like CD8 T cells, using NT-I7, a long-acting Fc-fused recombinant human IL-7 (efineptakin alfa).

These intracellular regulators control cytokine-mediated JAK/STAT signaling, thereby modulating immune activation.

creator: Doaa Hassanien, Rashid A AlYafei, Omar H Metwally, Izzaldin Alremawi, Abdulla Khalid Al-Kaabi, Mohamed Elahtem, Talal AL-Sayed, Mohamed A Yassin

While traditional therapies such as phlebotomy and hydroxyurea have been used for disease management, they do not address the underlying pathophysiology or alleviate common symptoms like fatigue and pruritus.

title: Chrysoeriol-Mediated Neuroprotection in Parkinson’s Disease in Mice: Targeting Apoptosis, α-Synuclein Accumulation, and Functional Recovery
creator: Mehak Ali, Mehwish Mehreen, Saima Batool, Shahrukh Khan, Aneeqa Noor, Sara Mumtaz, Saima Zafar
description: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder marked by the progressive loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta, leading to significant motor dysfunction. Current treatments stabilize dopamine levels but fail to address underlying neuronal apoptosis, highlighting the need for novel approaches.

creator: Linyi Zheng, Yuqiang Li, Cenap Güngör, Heming Ge
description: Autoimmune liver disease (AILD) is a group of immune-mediated chronic liver injury diseases of unknown etiology. The pathogenesis of AILD is not clear, and it poses a serious threat to human life and health for a long time. Several case reports and observational studies have shown that the Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) is directly associated with AILD.

title: Evaluation and Management Principles for Chronic Right Heart Failure and Tricuspid Regurgitation
creator: Revathy Sampath-Kumar, Andreas Rück, Aristomenis Manouras, Ori Ben-Yehuda, Lars H Lund, Bahira Shahim

title: Public Health and Residential Care Facilities: Geriatricians' Roles in the COVID‐19 Response and Beyond
creator: Meredith Greene, Belinda Tang, Anna H Chodos, Louise Aronson
description: ed. Despite increasingly serving residents with dementia and other medical vulnerabilities, RCFs pose unique challenges in infection control since they typically do not have medical directors or formal oversight by health departments [3, 4]. In 2020, San Francisco was the first city in the United States to declare a COVID‐19 state of emergency.

description: Dipeptidyl peptidase-IV (DPP-IV) inhibition is a validated therapeutic mechanism for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Marine-derived bioactive peptides offer a diverse array of potential inhibitors but often exhibit pharmacokinetic limitations that impede clinical translation. This study aimed to identify and evaluate candidate peptides from Arbacia lixula as potential DPP-IV inhibitors using an integrated in silico approach.

title: Impact of Age and Comorbidities On Therapeutic Decision-making Among Older Patients With Gastrointestinal Cancer
creator: Marianna Javier-González, Raffaele Galli, Carlos Amorós Rivera, Robert Rosenberg, Marcus Vetter
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeThe impact of age, comorbidities and geriatric syndromes is often overlooked during tumor board (TB) decisions. We investigated how frequently age, comorbidities, functional and nutritional parameters, and frailty are mentioned when deciding treatments for older adults with gastrointestinal (GI) cancers, and the impact these variables have on adherence to TB decisions and treatment guidelines from the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO).MethodsCross-sectional study of data from patients aged ≥ 65 years presented before the GI-TB of a tertiary cancer center between July

title: Policy Silences and the Case for Dedicated Legislation for Street Sweepers in India: Policy Content Analysis using the READ Approach
creator: Gajalakshmi Selvaraj, Abraham Prince Durai Elangovan, Sudalai Subramani, Mahalakshmy Thulasingam
description: Street sweepers play a vital role in sanitation through solid waste management. They are exposed to a number of occupational hazards, including dust, infectious agents, ergonomics-related disorders, and injuries. Street sweepers are identified as sanitary workers and also municipal solid waste management workers, resulting in fragmentation of guidelines, manuals and legislations governing street sweepers.

title: Diagnostic performance of dual-energy CT for opportunistic detection of rotator cuff disease: a retrospective multireader study
creator: Suwei Liu, Kai Ye, Yali Li, Aihui Di, Chenyu Jiang, Ming Ni, Huishu Yuan
description: ObjectivesMulti-material decomposition (MMD), a key application of dual-energy computed tomography (DECT), has shown potential in musculoskeletal research. This study aimed to compare the diagnostic performance of DECT-based MMD with standard CT and MRI in detecting rotator cuff disease.Materials and methodsThis retrospective study evaluated patients diagnosed with rotator cuff disease who underwent third-generation dual-source DECT and 3.

title: Molecular and Clinical Characterization of the Hb Tübingen [β106(G8) Leu→ Gln, HBB : c.320 T>A] Associated With Congenital Methemoglobinemia in a Chinese Family
creator: Hualei Luo, Zhenmin Ren, Yuhua Ye, Reem Nabil Hassan, Xiaoying Fu, Tao Wu, Yunsheng Chen, Xufeng Luo
description: BackgroundCongenital methemoglobinemia caused by hemoglobin variants is a rare hematological disorder often misdiagnosed due to overlapping features with enzymatic defects. Hb Tübingen, a β‐globin chain variant (βCD106), is characterized by increased autoxidation, heat instability, and cyanosis.MethodsA 7‐year‐old Chinese boy with cyanosis and recurrent neurological symptoms was evaluated using hemoglobin electrophoresis, HPLC, methemoglobin quantification, genetic sequencing, and brain imaging.

title: Research on 3D-printed scaffolds with microstructure bio-inspired optimization for orbital bone defect repair
creator: Xueman Lv, Yan Liu, Lina Wang, Xuanting Liu, Shuo Wang, Zihe Xu, Yunhai Ma
description: Mechanical compatibility is a major challenge in designing orbital bone scaffolds, which involving material selection, structural design and fabrication processes. In this study, a novel impact model database containing essential components involved in tissue engineering repair of orbital fracture was established for finite element analysis (FEA).

title: Maternal Haemoglobin and Haematocrit During Pregnancy and Stillbirth Risk: A Prospective, Population‐Based Birth Cohort Study
creator: Shuangying Li, Nina Dempsey, Shen Gao, Shaofei Su, Shuanghua Xie, Zhengyang Yao, Minhui Hu, Juan Li, Zhan Li, Enjie Zhang, Jianhui Liu, Hao Xing, Jinghan Yu, Shaowen Wu, Wentao Yue, Ruixia Liu, Alexander E P Heazell, Chenghong Yin
description: BackgroundMaternal anaemia is a public health issue globally, associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes. However, less is known about the effects of high haemoglobin (Hb) and haematocrit (Hct) on the risk of stillbirth.ObjectivesWe assessed the dose–response effects of dynamic changes in maternal Hb and Hct across all trimesters on stillbirth risk.

title: Technical aspects of SEEG limitations and solutions using the Leksell Vantage frame
creator: Insa Prilop, Stephan B Sobottka, Georg K Leonhardt, Ilker Y Eyüpoglu, Witold H Polanski
description: BackgroundStereo-electroencephalography (SEEG) is an invasive electroencephalography method to precisely locate a seizure onset zone (SOZ). While today´s armamentarium allows any compromise between the historically strict orthogonal and oblique trajectories, the following aspects limit its effectiveness and safety. The shorter the distance from entry to the brain and target the less deviation of the electrode.

title: A scientometric study on research trends and characteristics of tooth intentional replantation
creator: Yan Zhou, Simin Deng, Wenhua Xu, Wei Liu, Yibo Guo, Mingyi Zhu
description: Background/purposeIntentional replantation is regarded as a final strategy to preserve natural teeth affected by inaccessible endodontic and periodontal disease. The purpose of this study was to analyze the scientometric characteristics and research trends of tooth intentional replantation.Materials and methodsAll the papers on intentional replantation were comprehensively retrieved from the Scopus database.

title: Deep learning-based vessel and nerve recognition model for lateral lymph node dissection: a retrospective feasibility study
creator: Shoma Sasaki, Daichi Kitaguchi, Tomohiro Noda, Hiroki Matsuzaki, Hiro Hasegawa, Nobuyoshi Takeshita, Masaaki Ito
description: PurposeLateral lymph node dissection for rectal cancer is challenging because of the presence of blood vessels and nerves essential for postoperative genitourinary function and leg movements. Identifying these structures during surgery is crucial. We developed a deep learning-based semantic segmentation model to recognize and visualize critical anatomical structures during laparoscopic lateral lymph node dissection automatically.

title: Surgical management and long-term functional outcomes of traumatic pubic symphysis diastasis: a retrospective cohort study
creator: Rajendra Aryal, Rajan Bhusal, Nitesh Raj Pandey, Ashok Kumar Banskota, Bibek Banskota
description: BackgroundSurgical management of traumatic pubic symphysis diastasis is essential for restoring pelvic stability, yet functional outcomes remain variable. This study aimed to evaluate the functional outcomes and identify predictors of recovery following this intervention at a Level 1 trauma centre in Nepal.

title: Learning curve and perioperative outcomes of robotic-assisted distal pancreatectomy: a single-center study
creator: Yizhang Zhu, Jiayue Zou, Daobin Wang, Danyang Shen, Xiaofeng Xue, Weigang Zhang, Lei Qin
description: To examine the learning curve and perioperative outcomes of robotic-assisted distal pancreatectomy (RDP) conducted at a single center and to contextualize these findings against existing literature. A single expert surgical team conducted RDP on 106 patients at the Department of Hepatobiliary and Pancreatic Surgery, The First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University, from January 2021 to December 2024.

title: The Leeuwenhoek paradox in dental artificial intelligence: A narrative review of artificial intelligence-detected subclinical periapical changes and human-labeled false positives
creator: Etyene Schnurr, Mario Parra, David M Kim
description: This narrative review explores the “Leeuwenhoek Paradox,” a metaphorical and conceptual challenge that arises when artificial intelligence (AI) detects subtle periapical radiological changes that are not visible to human observers. Drawing on evidence from studies using two-dimensional and cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) imaging, this review critically examined the limitations of human-centered reference standards and recurrent discrepancies in AI-based periapical detection.

title: Structural causes of pattern formation and loss through model-independent bifurcation analysis
creator: Liam D O’Brien, Adriana T Dawes
description: During development, precise cellular patterning is essential for the formation of functional tissues and organs. These patterns arise from conserved signaling networks that regulate communication both within and between cells. Here, we develop and present a model-independent ordinary differential equation (ODE) framework for analyzing pattern formation in a homogeneous cell array.

title: Lactate combined with lymphocyte counts as useful predictors for the severity and prognosis of necrotizing enterocolitis: a retrospective cohort study
creator: Dabin Huang, Yuying Lin, Yueju Cai, Zhihui Chen, Zhenyu Liang, Xiaowen Chen, Heng Su, Mou Wei, Qiong Meng, Wei Zhou
description: BackgroundNecrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) lacks useful biomarkers for early risk stratification. Despite evidence of lactate metabolism and immune dysregulation in NEC pathogenesis, their synergistic diagnostic potential remains underexplored.MethodThis retrospective cohort study analyzed 118 neonates with NEC (2017–2022), stratified into two subgroups: mild NEC (Bell’s stage ≤ IIa, n = 59) and severe NEC (Bell’s stage ≥ IIb, n = 59).

title: The CCR/WC ratio as a predictor of dyslipidemia and Its mediating effect on hypertension in middle-aged and older adults
creator: Yang Yang, Yufang Hu, Xiaodan Li, Qi Sun
description: BackgroundThe creatinine-to-cystatin C/waist circumference ratio (CCR/WC) combines renal function and adiposity metrics, yet its predictive value for dyslipidemia remains undefined. This research examined CCR/WC’s capacity as a dyslipidemia biomarker and its mediating role in hypertension pathogenesis.MethodsUtilizing the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS) cohort, we employed multivariable-adjusted logistic regression and Cox proportional hazards models to quantify CCR/WC-dyslipidemia associations.

title: Fluvastatin enhances healing of medication–related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ) via macrophage polarization in a rat MRONJ–like model
creator: Moa Tazaki, Koma Sanda, Hiroko Wada, Bin Ji, Yohei Jinno, Yasunori Ayukawa
description: Background/purposeMedication–related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ), a serious adverse effect of antiresorptive agents, remains difficult to manage. Our previous studies showed that statins, widely prescribed for dyslipidemia, promote healing in MRONJ–like lesions, however, the mechanisms underlying their therapeutic effects remain unclear.

title: Enhanced discrimination of Clostridioides difficile transmission using whole-genome sequencing and in silico multi-locus variable number tandem repeat analysis
creator: Alexander J. Sundermann, Emma G. Mills, Vatsala Rangachar Srinivasa, Marissa P. Griffith, Deena Ereifej, Kady D. Waggle, Nathan J. Raabe, Graham M. Snyder, Daria Van Tyne, Lora Lee Pless, Lee H. Harrison
description: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) is used to establish genetic relatedness of bacteria and track outbreaks in healthcare settings. While WGS provides sufficient discriminatory power to make inferences about genetic relatedness and transmission for most bacterial species, WGS for Clostridioides difficile often fails to do so, even at low single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) differences.

title: Leveraging experience-based co-design to support an innovative health workforce: a graduate certificate in health services innovation case study
creator: Jennifer Kosiol, Michaela Smyth, Louise D’Allura, Mark Avery
description: BackgroundThe dual challenge of population growth and ageing is placing unprecedented pressure on Australia’s healthcare system, necessitating innovative approaches to workforce education and service delivery. This case study examines how Experience-Based Co-Design (EBCD) can be applied to a postgraduate workforce education program to strengthen healthcare professionals’ capability in navigating complex systems.

title: Er:YAG laser-assisted connective tissue wall technique for periodontal regeneration in a soft tissue recession combined with a furcation-involved class II subclass B molar under a microscope: A case report
creator: Shao-Yu Chang, Yoichi Taniguchi, Akira Aoki, Taichen Lin
description: e.1,2 Under microscopic visualization, the fine sapphire tip of the Er:YAG laser allow s effective access to anatomically restricted areas, such as furcation defects, facilitating thorough debridement of inflamed granulation tissue and calculus.3 In addition, the photobiomodulation effect of ErL has been reported to enhance wound healing and periodontal regeneration.

title: Osteoclast-derived exosomes promote medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw by delivering glycoRNA to disrupt the blood–lymphatic vascular network
creator: Jiankang Zhang, Junming Tao, Chengzhi Zhao, Jian Pan
description: Background/purposeMedication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ) is a metabolic disorder of the jaw characterized by bone necrosis. Its pathogenesis remains unclear, and elucidating the underlying mechanisms and pathological changes is essential for addressing the clinical challenge of refractory jaw necrosis in MRONJ.

title: Brown adipose tissue and skeletal muscle coordinately contribute to thermogenesis in mice
creator: Yuna Izumi-Mishima, Rie Tsutsumi, Tetsuya Shiuchi, Saori Fujimoto, Momoka Taniguchi, Mizuki Sugiuchi, Manaka Tsutsumi, Yuko Okamatsu-Ogura, Takeshi Yoneshiro, Masashi Kuroda, Kazuhiro Nomura, Hiroshi Sakaue, Dudley W Lamming, Yuna Izumi-Mishima, Rie Tsutsumi, Tetsuya Shiuchi, Saori Fujimoto, Momoka
description: Endotherms increase the rate of metabolism in metabolic organs as one strategy to cope with a decline in the temperature of the external environment. However, an additional major contributor to maintenance of body temperature in a cold environment is contraction-based thermogenesis in skeletal muscle.

title: Dental age—based assessment of retromolar morphology in skeletal Class III patients: Implications for mandibular third molar development
creator: Thuy-Trang Thi Ho, Tu Manh Nguyen, Loc Minh Lu, Fang-Yu Fan, Ying-Sui Sun, Yang-Che Wu, Sheng-Wei Feng, Chien-Fu Tseng, Pao-Chang Chiang, I-Ta Lee
description: Background/purposeIn skeletal Class III malocclusion, evaluation of mandibular third molar development is clinically important for orthodontic treatment planning, particularly in relation to posterior space conditions. This study aimed to assess the association between dental age of mandibular third molars and retromolar morphological characteristics in skeletal Class III patients.

title: Adherence properties and adhesin-encoding genes detected in enteroaggregative Escherichia coli (EAEC)
creator: Guilherme F. R. de Souza, Gustavo B. Bueno, Daiany R. P. de Lira, Iranildo do A. Fernandes, Henrique Orsi, Beatrice D. V. L. Souza, Bruna M. Luiz, Luísa Pereira, Luís F. dos Santos, Waldir P. Elias, Rodrigo T. Hernandes
description: Enteroaggregative Escherichia coli (EAEC) is an enteropathogen that harbors a set of adhesins responsible for mediating adherence to epithelial cells in a stacked brick-like arrangement termed aggregative adherence (AA) pattern and is one of the main pathogens isolated from diarrheal patients worldwide.

title: Development of a survey evaluating patient Concerns Over Peri‐operative Events (COPE)
creator: A. J. Gardner, T. Potter, P. Greig, G. Radcliffe, J. E. O'Carroll, K. El‐Boghdadly
description: SummaryAnxiety frequently burdens patients before surgery, potentially leading to poorer recovery. However, standard assessment tools typically quantify the intensity of this distress without understanding its root cause. This often leaves clinicians unaware of the specific fears driving a patient's anxiety. We aimed to address this deficit by developing and validating a questionnaire designed to identify individual pre‐operative concerns.

title: Temperature-driven metabolic adaptation in thermophilic microbial communities of Western Sichuan hot springs
creator: Sainan Luo, Xiuzhen Chen, Shunchao Guo, Songnian Hu, Zhiyang Dong, Jianing Geng
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundUnderstanding microbial adaptation to extreme environments remains a key challenge in microbial ecology. Geothermal hot springs, characterized by temperature gradients and varying geochemical conditions, represent valuable natural laboratories for studying microbial diversity, adaptive strategies, and evolutionary mechanisms.

title: The signal peptide of staphylococcal protein A alters the multimeric states of PepV
creator: Muhammad S. Azam, Dominique Missiakas
description: Signal peptides (SPs) have traditionally been recognized as molecular address tags that direct protein translocation between subcellular compartments. However, emerging evidence suggests that they serve additional functions beyond their canonical role in protein trafficking. In this study, we investigate the signal peptide of staphylococcal protein A (SpA), which contains the YSIRK/GXXS motif and facilitates translocation at bacterial cross-walls.

title: Severe respiratory complications in late-diagnosed Prader–Willi syndrome: a case report
creator: Surya Kant Tiwari, Poonam Joshi, Nihar Ranjan Mishra, Rimjhim Sonowal, Niladri Sekhar Bhunia
description: BackgroundPrader–Willi syndrome is a rare neuroendocrine genetic disorder that causes hypothalamic dysfunction, hyperphagia, and morbid obesity. Early diagnosis is critical to prevent life-threatening complications. This case report details the fatal outcome of a patient with late-diagnosed Prader–Willi syndrome, highlighting the consequences of diagnostic delay and management challenges in a low-resource setting.

title: The weight of words: Language and ethics in pediatric palliative care
creator: Haley Sherburne, Brenda Schiltz
description: onate about nail art, hunting, and photography – was nearing the end of life after a prolonged struggle with metastatic osteosarcoma. Her parents made a different choice: they opted not to implement a DNR policy. They needed to know that everything was done to save their daughter. Whose parent made the right decision? Language carries weight.

title: Autoimmune glial fibrillary acidic protein astrocytopathy with full-length spinal cord lesions: a case report and literature review
creator: Mengyi Huang, Qunbo Jia, Yushu Ouyang, Xiaoteng Feng, Ronghui Ju
description: BackgroundAutoimmune glial fibrillary acidic protein astrocytopathy (GFAP-A) is an autoimmune inflammatory disease of the central nervous system triggered by GFAP. Currently, the diagnosis is mainly based on the detection of autoantibodies that recognize GFAP in the cerebrospinal fluid. Its imaging manifestations are complex and variable.

title: Clinically altered brain activity may not look like aged brain activity: Implications for brain‐age modeling and biomarker strategies
creator: Lukas A W Gemein, Sinead Gaubert, Claire Paquet, Joseph Paillard, Sebastian C Holst, Thomas Tveitstøl, Ira R J H Haraldsen, Tony Kam‐Thong, David J Hawellek, Jörg F Hipp, Denis A Engemann

The BAG captures brain atrophy as measured with structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Electroencephalography (EEG) has also been explored for estimating the BAG (EEG‐BAG).

title: Surgical management of ovarian endometrioma in a patient with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva: a case report
creator: Tingting Ye, Yongjun Kang, Qiqi Zhang, Hong Chen, Xiafei Xie, Zhujun Li, Yifeng Tang, Tingting Zhang, Yan Wang, Hongyan Li
description: BackgroundFibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP) is an ultra-rare (prevalence ~ 1:2 million), devastating genetic disorder characterized by progressive heterotopic ossification. Crucially, surgical trauma is a potent trigger for catastrophic new bone formation, rendering any procedure exceptionally high-risk and generally contraindicated. The co-occurrence of FOP with a symptomatic ovarian endometrioma necessitating surgery represents an extraordinary clinical rarity.

title: Historical Blood Serum Samples from Wilmington, North Carolina: The Importance of Ultrashort-Chain Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances
creator: Lan Cheng, Sarah Teagle, Jeffrey R. Enders, Rebecca A. Weed, Hazel B. Nichols, Detlef R.U. Knappe, Jane A. Hoppin
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). From 1980 to 2017, Wilmington, North Carolina (NC), residents unknowingly consumed high levels of PFAS through drinking water. Some of these PFAS are expected to have short biological half-lives, and current biological sampling will miss these exposures. To assess historical PFAS exposures, we (1) determined PFAS levels in serum samples of Wilmington, NC residents obtained during the years 2010–2016, (2) examined temporal trends of serum PFAS over this period, and (3) associated serum PFAS levels with PFAS concentrations in drinking water.

title: Developing anti-inflammatory mineral trioxide aggregate as dental implant crown cement to reduce peri-implantitis incidence
creator: Yung-Fu Hsu, Sea-Fue Wang, Yi-Le Liao, Chih-Sheng Lin, Ssu-Chi Chen, Sheng-Yang Lee, Wei-Chun Lin
description: Background/purposeDental resin cement residue around periodontal tissue is one of the causes of peri-implantitis. Severe cases may cause the implant to loosen or fall off. Therefore, the goal of this study was to modify mineral trioxide aggregate as an anti-inflammatory dental implant crown cement (ICC).

title: Protection against H9N2 challenge in chickens via Salmonella with a focA mutation delivered by a dendritic cell-targeted avian influenza virus NA protein tetramer
creator: Chongbo Ge, Yan Sun, Qiyu Guo, Gerui Zhang, Futing Jia, Tongyu Zhang, Yawen Tian, Wenfeng Wang, Yingkai He, Tianrui Yang, Yupeng Gao, Yuxi Zhang, Yuhang Zhang, Mingyue Wang, Jingshuo Gong, Haibin Huang, Zhannan Wang, Chunfeng Wang, Yanlong Jiang

The influenza neuraminidase (NA) enzyme is a promising candidate for a conserved influenza vaccine, offering long-term and effective cross-protection against the disease. The aim of this study is to develop a Salmonella-vectored vaccine with strong protective efficacy against H9N2 avian influenza virus.

title: Strategy of allying general dentistry staffs into pre-anesthetic dental assessment reduces perioperative dental injury risk during general anesthesia
creator: I-Cheng Lu, Mei-Chun Chen, Po-Yang Chen, Tz-Ping Gau, Edward Chengchuan Ko, Kuang-I Cheng
description: Background/purposePerioperative dental injury remains a common complication during general anesthesia. This study aimed to evaluate whether professional dentistry intervention in pre-anesthetic assessment reduces the risk of perioperative dental injury.Materials and methodsThis retrospective cohort study analyzed data from 119,656 patients who underwent general anesthesia between May 2013 and April 2021.

title: Fungal–bacterial interaction networks in lignocellulose degradation: an integrated ecological and mechanistic perspective
creator: Yun-Yeong Lee, Jeonghee Yun
description: Lignocellulosic biomass (LCB) degradation is the process by which fungi and bacteria contribute complementarily at multiple organizational levels. This review integrates their enzymatic, ecological, and metabolic roles, and suggests the linkage structure between the microbial community dynamics and the design of synthetic microbial consortia.

title: Engaging patient-led rare disease organizations to advance research – through the lens of Bardet–Biedl syndrome
creator: Timothy Ogden, Bendert de Graaf, Tonia Hymers
description: For researchers and clinician-scientists, forging partnerships with patient-led rare disease organizations can be a challenge. Patient-led rare disease organizations often operate quite differently to research and medical institutions, large private or public funding organizations, and pharmaceutical or biotechnology companies, leaving researchers and clinician-scientists uncertain about how, when and where to engage for mutual benefit.

title: Rigorous validation of machine learning models for orthodontic extraction prediction using nested cross-validation and smotenc-integrated pipelines
creator: Anh Thi-Ngoc Do, Hung Trong Hoang, Trang Thi-Thuy Ho, Hieu Ngoc Le
description: Background/purposeMachine learning (ML) in orthodontics often suffers from optimistic bias due to data leakage and improper handling of class imbalance. This study implemented and evaluated a production-grade validation framework - nested cross-validation (CV) - for three distinct algorithm classes (logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting) using a consensus-labeled orthodontic dataset.

title: Intracellular Binding of Novel Fluorinated Compounds to Carbonic Anhydrase Isoforms Explored by In-Cell 19F NMR
creator: Azzurra Costantino, Letizia Barbieri, Simone Giovannuzzi, Alessio Nocentini, Claudiu T. Supuran, Mindaugas Raitelaitis, Pär Nordlund, Lucia Banci, Enrico Luchinat
description: One of the most important challenges of drug development is identifying whether a candidate molecule can efficiently reach and engage intracellular targets. Cell-based assays are usually employed to address this issue; nevertheless, many compounds that appear promising in vitro fail in cellular or in vivo contexts due to low intracellular activity or off-target effects.

title: TCMNet: an AI-driven strategy for optimizing traditional Chinese medicine
creator: Shuoyan Tan, Xin Shao, Xuting Zhang, Yizheng Dai, Boli Zhang, Yiyu Cheng, Xiaohui Fan
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundArtificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), have provided powerful tools for systematically modeling the complexity of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). To overcome the limitations of subjective formula design and unweighted target prioritization, we developed TCMNet, an AI-powered strategy that integrates LLM-assisted disease knowledge mining, protein–protein interaction (PPI) networks, and deep learning-based binding prediction to support herbal formula evaluation and active compounds identification.MethodsTCMNet integrates AI-guided literature analysis with weighted PPI network evaluation.

title: Higher serum gastric parietal cell antibody titers are associated with increased frequencies of macrocytosis, vitamin B12 deficiency, and hyperhomocysteinemia in patients with oral lichen planus
creator: Yu-Hsueh Wu, Yi-Pang Lee, Julia Yu-Fong Chang, Yi-Ping Wang, Andy Sun, Chun-Pin Chiang

Background/purposeOur previous study found 139 gastric parietal cell antibody (GPCA)-positive oral lichen planus (OLP) patients (GPCA+OLP patients) in a group of 588 OLP patients. This study evaluated whether higher-titer (serum GPCA titer ≥160) GPCA+OLP patients had greater frequencies of macrocytosis, anemia, serum iron and vitamin B12 deficiencies, and hyperhomocysteinemia than lower-titer (GPCA titer ≥80) GPCA+OLP patients or 588 healthy control subjects.Materials and methodsComplete blood count, serum iron, vitamin B12, folic acid, homocysteine, and GPCA levels in 53 higher-titer GPCA+OLP patients, 86 lower-titer

title: The impact of sleep duration on the incidence of new-onset chronic kidney disease in community-dwelling adults: a nationwide cohort study
creator: Jung-Hwan Kim, Min-Jin Ha, Dong-Woo Choi, Sohee Park
description: BackgroundThis research examined the association between sleep duration and new-onset chronic kidney disease (CKD) among community-dwelling middle-aged and elderly individuals in Korea.MethodsThis prospective cohort study utilized data from the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study (KoGES) from 2001–2002 (baseline) to 2019–2020 (tenth follow-up visit). New-onset CKD was the primary outcome, defined as an estimated glomerular filtration rate <60 mL/min/1.

title: PM2.5及其化学组分长期暴露对中老年人衰弱发生的影响：一项前瞻性队列研究
creator: 坤 陈, 倩 刘, 晨晨 吴, 力华 杨, 小军 林
description: 目的探讨PM2.5及其化学组分长期暴露对中老年人衰弱发生风险的影响。方法基于2011–2020年中国健康与养老追踪调查和大气成分近实时追踪数据集开展前瞻性队列研究。采用衰弱指数评估衰弱状况，运用时间依赖的Cox比例风险模型分析PM2.5及其化学组分（黑碳、有机化合物、硫酸盐、硝酸盐、铵盐）长期暴露对衰弱发生风险的影响。结果研究共纳入9603名受访者。在调整混杂因素后，受访者过去一年平均暴露于PM2.5质量浓度每增加一个四分位距，衰弱发生风险升高10.0%〔风险比（hazard ratio, HR）=1.100，95%置信区间（confidence interval, CI）：1.015～1.193〕。在具体化学组分方面，有机化合物、黑碳、铵盐、硫酸盐、硝酸盐等长期暴露浓度每增加一个四分位距，衰弱风险分别升高14.2%（HR=1.142，95%CI：1.055～1.236）、13.1%（HR=1.131，95%CI：1.041～1.229）、9.8%（HR=1.098，95%CI：1.010～1.194）、8.8%（HR=1.088，95%CI：0.996～1.187）和8.1%（HR=1.081，95%CI：0.996～1.172）。结论PM2.5及黑碳、有机化合物、铵盐等化学组分长期暴露是中老年人衰弱发生的风险因素。建议在环境政策制定中优先加强对黑碳及有机气溶胶排放的控制，以降低空气污染对人口老龄化背景下的公共卫生负担。 衰弱是一种与慢性疾病患病情况、日常生活活动能力和心理健康密切相关的临床综合征[1-2]，表现为个体的稳态储备减少，对内源性压力的易感性增强。全球范围内，有数百万老年人患有衰弱[1]，2021年大约24%的人口处于衰弱状态[3]，其高患病率所造成的个人医疗保健支出及社会经济负担不容小觑。流行病学证据表明，衰弱可使住院死亡率升高6倍，住院时间增加55%，住院费用增加29%[4]。经济负担分析显示，衰弱个体月均超额医疗支出达457美元，其中住院费用占75%[5]，且医疗保健支出占总护理费用的40%～76%[6]。值得注意的是，衰弱使发生灾难性医疗支出（自付费用≥家庭支付能力40%）的风险显著增加3.19倍[7]，这对医疗保障体系形成严峻考验。寻找并控制衰弱的驱动因素，对降低老龄化社会疾病负担具有重要战略意义。 衰弱的发生发展涉及遗传-环境-疾病的复杂交互作用，其中空气污染的致病机制近年来备受关注[8-9]。流行病学研究表明，PM2.5作为非传染性疾病的重要环境风险因子，2019年在全球范围内共导致超过420万人过早死亡[10]。大气颗粒物致病机制的相关研究发现，PM2.5能通过诱导系统性氧化应激及慢性低度炎症，引发血管内皮功能障碍[11]、代谢紊乱[12]，以及神经退行性病变[13]，进而加速多器官功能衰退，与衰弱的核心病理特征（肌力下降、平衡失调及认知受损）存在显著关联[14-15]。颗粒物化学组分相关研究发现，PM2.5及其关键组分（碳质气溶胶、二次无机离子等）可通过诱导呼吸系统的氧化应激、炎症和微生物生态失调，促进慢性阻塞性肺疾病的发病[16]。尽管我国近年来加强空气污染治理，但PM2.5空气污染问题依然突出，其长期暴露对中老年人群衰弱发生风险的影响亟需精准评估。 本研究利用2011–2020年中国健康与养老追踪调查（China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, CHARLS）的数据，结合大气成分近实时追踪数据集（Tracking Air Pollution, TAP）中的PM2.5及化学组分数据，分析PM2.5及其化学组分〔黑碳（black carbon, BC）、有机化合物（organic matter, OM）、硫酸盐（sulfate, SO42－）、硝酸盐（nitrate, NO3－）、铵盐（ammonium, NH4+）〕长期暴露与中老年人群衰弱发生风险的关联，并进一步揭示污染物暴露的人口学异质性，为识别易感人群及制定靶向性环境健康干预策略提供科学依据。 资料与方法 数据来源 CHARLS是针对我国45岁及以上中老年人家庭和个人的追踪调查，覆盖28个省（自治区、直辖市）、150个县、450个社区（村），约1万户家庭中的1.7万人。CHARLS于2011年进行全国基线调查，分别于2013年、2015年、2018年和2020年进行了4轮追踪随访调查。该调查经北京大学伦理委员会批准（IRB00001052-11015）成立，所有参与者签署知情同意书。空气污染暴露数据来源于TAP数据集[17]。该数据集构建了自2000年以来具有长期历史记录并持续动态更新的PM2.5及其化学组分全覆盖数据，空间分辨率为10 km。依据各化学组分对PM2.5总质量的相对贡献，对污染物浓度进行组分划分，量化了碳质气溶胶（以BC为代表）、二次无机气溶胶（以SO42－、NO3－和NH4+为主要组分）以及有机物（OM，包括有机碳及微量多环芳烃、烷烃等）等主要成分的浓度水平。验证结果显示，TAP数据集中PM2.5及其化学组分浓度与地面监测数据具有较高一致性，相关系数介于0.67～0.80之间。气象因素数据（温度及相对湿度）来源于中国区域地面气象要素驱动数据集2.0版本。该数据集融合了欧洲中期天气预报中心的ERA5再分析数据与地面气象站观测数据，并结合人工智能技术进行数据融合，时间分辨率为3 h，水平空间分辨率为0.1°，时间跨度长达74年（1951—2024年）[18]。 研究对象 本研究基于CHARLS 2011年基线调查数据构建前瞻性队列，整合4轮随访数据，获取研究对象的基本人口学特征及衰弱状态相关信息。研究对象的纳入标准为：①基线年龄≥45岁；②至少参加两轮调查的受访者。排除标准：①基线调查时发生衰弱状况者（衰弱定义见“1.3 衰弱测量”部分）；②随访期间衰弱状况评估次数不足2次者；③在任意轮次随访过程中缺失关键研究协变量者；④因居住地区空气污染暴露数据缺失而无法完成暴露匹配的受访者。最后，本研究共计纳入9603名受访者（图1）。 Flowchart for the inclusion and exclusion of participants 受访者纳入排除流程图 衰弱测量 本研究依据健康相关赤字累积的标准程序构建衰弱指数（frailty index, FI），以评估受访者的衰弱状况，结合CHARLS问卷结构及既往研究经验，筛选了32项多维健康指标（12项慢性病史、10项日常活动能力、7项身体功能、抑郁状态、认知功能和自我报告健康状况）用于构建FI[19]，详见网络资源附件附表1。其中，31项为二分类变量（0表示无赤字，1表示存在赤字），认知功能指标作为连续变量，标准化至0.00～1.00区间，数值越低代表认知能力越好。个体FI值通过累积赤字数除以总指标数标准化为0.00～1.00之间的连续变量，数值越高表明衰弱状态越严重。依据既往研究定义，当FI≥0.25时判定为衰弱状态[1]。本研究采用统一标准计算受访者在基线及随访期间各时间点的FI，据此判断其在随访过程中是否发生衰弱。 空气污染暴露测量 使用TAP数据集2008年1月1日–2020年12月31日期间的PM2.5及其化学组分质量浓度数据，依据CHARLS问卷中受访者居住的地级市信息和调查时间对受访者进行空气污染暴露水平评估。由于空气污染暴露存在滞后效应，本研究将受访者前1年PM2.5及其化学组分（BC、NO3－、SO42－、NH4+和OM）的平均暴露质量浓度作为其长期空气污染暴露的水平。同时，研究评估了受访者前2年和前3年平均PM2.5及其化学组分的暴露水平，并进行了敏感性分析。 协变量 基于既往研究[14, 19-20]，本研究纳入多项社会人口学特征及健康行为变量作为协变量。社会人口学变量包括性别、年龄、居住地类型（城市/农村）、婚姻状况（已婚同居、分居/离异/丧偶/未婚）、受教育水平（小学及以下、中学、大学及以上）、工作与否（是、否）、收入水平（依据家庭人均支出的三分位数分别定义为较低、中等、较高水平）以及医疗保险（无医疗保险、城镇职工基本医疗保险、城镇居民基本医疗保险、新型农村合作医疗以及其他医疗保险）。健康行为变量包括吸烟状况（从不吸烟、戒烟及正在吸烟）、饮酒状况（从不饮酒、戒酒及正在饮酒）。此外，考虑到气象因素可能的混杂影响，本研究在所有回归模型中均调整了受访者前1年其所在地级市的平均气温（℃）和平均相对湿度（%）。 统计学方法 在描述性分析中，连续型变量以中位数和四分位距（interquartile range, IQR）描述，分类变量以频数和百分比表示。本研究构建时间依赖的Cox比例风险回归模型评估空气污染长期暴露与衰弱发生风险的关联。在模型中，采用限制性立方样条方法对PM2.5及其化学组分浓度，以及环境温度和相对湿度进行建模，评估PM2.5及其化学组分与衰弱发生风险之间的剂量-反应曲线。空气污染物效应的非线性特征通过似然比检验进行评估。此外，依据性别、年龄、居住地类型等协变量划分开展亚组分析，探讨长期PM2.5及其化学组分暴露与不同特征中老年人群衰弱发生风险的差异化影响。所有统计检验均为双侧检验，显著性水平设定为α=0.05。所有统计分析均在R软件（version 4.4.2）中完成。 结果 一般情况 本研究共纳入2011年基线加入队列的受访者9603人。在随访期间内，衰弱累积发生率为33.1%（3183例）。附表2展示了2011年基线时的研究人群基本特征。研究人群的年龄中位数为56岁，女性占比52.2%。37.7%的受访者居住于农村地区，大部分受访者（91.4%）为已婚同居状态。在受教育水平方面，38.1%受访者接受了完整的小学教育。在健康行为方面，30.7%及26.1%的受访对象在基线时仍存在吸烟或饮酒行为。在空气污染暴露水平方面，受访对象的PM2.5平均暴露质量浓度为45.7 µg/m3，BC、OM、SO42－、NH4+以及NO3－等化学组分的平均暴露质量浓度分别为2.

title: Burden and predictors of cervical cancer mortality in Sub-Saharan Africa: a systematic review and meta-analysis
creator: Tadele Emagneneh, Chalie Mulugeta, Betelhem Ejigu, Abebaw Alamrew, Belay Susu, Nigusie Abebaw, Aynalem Yetwale Hiwot, Habtam Desse Alemayehu, Sefineh Fenta Feleke
description: BackgroundCervical cancer remains a major public health concern, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa, where limited access to vaccination, screening, and treatment contributes to high mortality. Identifying mortality patterns and key risk factors is essential for designing effective interventions. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to estimate cervical cancer-related mortality and identify its common predictors among women in the region.

title: A co-created randomised controlled feasibility trial of a peer-led complex oral health intervention in UK secondary schools: the RAISED In Yorkshire RiY study protocol
creator: Yasmen Elsadek, Aruche-A-Noor Hamid, Poonam Anand, Lucy Simpson, Holly Davis, Flavian Kow, Neha Mehta, Nina Fraser, Abigail Turner, Minnie Lyons-Coleman, David Cooper, SMILE AIDER Patient Public Involvement, Engagement Forum, Sue H. Pavitt
description: BackgroundTooth decay in secondary school children is one of the most prevalent non-communicable diseases in the UK and globally. Whilst almost entirely preventable, oral health inequalities remain a significant public health problem to reach and manage those most vulnerable. School-based prevention strategies targeted to localities with oral health inequality, and incorporating peer-to-peer interventions warrant further evaluation.

title: Benefits of different characteristics of pulmonary rehabilitation programs in patients with interstitial lung disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
creator: Qian Chen, Yifan Qiu, Mengchun Xu, Liang Dong
description: BackgroundInterstitial lung disease (ILD) is defined by progressive pulmonary fibrosis, restrictive ventilatory dysfunction, and hypoxemia, with significant differences in disease presentation, clinical course, and prognosis. This study aims to evaluate the clinical benefits of pulmonary rehabilitation with different characteristics in ILD patients.

title: Orthokeratinized odontogenic cyst of the mandible - A case report
creator: Hung-Pin Lin, Chun-Pin Chiang
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). yst (OKC), a relatively more common odontogenic cyst compared to OOC. The report of this OOC case was reviewed and approved by the Institutional Review Board at the MacKay Memorial Hospital, Taipei, Taiwan (26MMHIS011e). This 46-year-old male patient had visited one of the hospitals in the New Taipei City in Taiwan due to painful swelling of the left posterior mandibular area. Incisional biopsy of the lesion revealed an OKC.

title: MUSCLE STRENGTH AND STIFFNESS OF ELBOW MUSCLES: CORRELATION WITH UPPER LIMB MOTOR FUNCTIONS IN PEOPLE WITH CHRONIC STROKE
creator: Shamay SM NG, Peiming CHEN, Shun Hei CHOI, Tung Ji LAM, Hei Yee LAU, Hing Ki LAU, Ho Yeung LAW, Desmond YW LAM, Cynthia YY LAI
description: ObjectiveTo (i) quantify elbow flexor and extensor strength and stiffness in people with stroke; (ii) compare affected and unaffected sides; (iii) compare stroke survivors and healthy older adults; and (iv) examine correlations between muscle properties, motor control, and ADLs.DesignCross-sectional study.Participants65 stroke survivors and 31 healthy older adults.MethodsElbow muscle strength and stiffness (biceps and triceps) were assessed bilaterally by Myoton PRO.

title: Upper extremity fractures and subsequent total knee arthroplasty incidence in knee osteoarthritis: a cross-continental propensity score-matched cohort study
creator: Wen-Chi Chan, Yu-Chen Tsai, Wen-Tien Wu, Ru-Ping Lee, Ing-Ho Chen, Tzai-Chiu Yu, Ji-Ze Hsu, Jen-Hung Wang, Kuang-Ting Yeh
description: BackgroundKnee osteoarthritis (KOA) represents a major clinical and economic burden globally, and total knee arthroplasty (TKA) remains the definitive treatment for end-stage disease. Upper extremity fractures in older adults often indicate skeletal fragility and reduced physiological reserve, but their influence on subsequent TKA incidence remains unclear. We investigated whether upper extremity fractures influence TKA incidence among patients with KOA.

title: 针灸治疗干预下脑梗死恢复期患者并发肺部感染的列线图预测模型构建及验证
creator: Jin Hu, Haoran Chu, Ying Wang, Chenglong Li
description: 目的分析针灸治疗干预下的脑梗死恢复期患者并发肺部感染的危险因素，并构建列线图模型。方法按照建模集与验证集7∶3比例，选择2022年1月—2024年1月期间在院内治疗的350例脑梗死患者为建模集。同时选择2024年2月至2024年12月收治的150例脑梗死患者作为验证集。收集患者一般资料、实验室指标及针灸干预变量，在建模集中使用LASSO回归筛选变量后进行多因素logistic回归，基于多因素回归结果建立列线图预测模型，分别在建模集和验证集中进行模型评价。结果脑梗死恢复期患者肺部感染发生率26.20%（131/500），其中建模集患者95例，共检出147株病原菌，以革兰阴性菌为主。建模集中，LASSO回归及logistic多因素向后逐步回归法筛选出肺部感染的危险因素为年龄增加（OR=1.043，95%CI：1.010～1.077）、进食评估问卷调查工具-10（EAT-10）评分升高（OR=1.249，95%CI：1.125～1.387）、有侵入性操作（OR=2.715，95%CI：1.340～5.501）、美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表（NIHSS）评分升高（OR=2.477，95%CI：1.951～3.144）、白蛋白降低（OR=0.856，95%CI：0.786～0.931）、前白蛋白降低（OR=0.992，95%CI：0.987～0.997）、留针时间为30 min（OR=2.439，95%CI：1.146～5.191）、针灸疗程<14 d（OR=2.463，95%CI：1.157～5.243）以及发病后>3 d介入针灸治疗（OR=2.660，95%CI：1.190～5.942）。据此构建列线图模型，该模型在建模集和验证集中的曲线下面积（AUC）为0.916（95%CI：0.877～0.954）、0.923（95%CI：0.874～0.973），校正曲线证实模型预测概率与实际概率吻合度较高，应用可产生正向临床净效益。结论基于Lasso-Logistic回归构建的列线图模型能够识别针灸干预下的脑梗死恢复期患者肺部感染风险，通过量化风险因素可指导患者优化针灸治疗方案、实现精准干预，降低感染风险。Keywords: 针灸, 脑梗死恢复期, 肺部感染, 列线图, 预测模型 脑卒中是全世界第二大常见死因，每年超过600万人死于该病，近年呈现显著年轻化趋势[1]。其中脑梗死约占全部脑卒中的70%以上，我国每年新发脑梗死病例超287万，发病人数居于全球首位[2]。最新数据显示，我国60岁以上人群脑梗死患病率已达3.5 %，40-60岁人群发病率相较于十年前上升30%[3]。肺部感染是脑梗死恢复期常见并发症，在不同地区和国家发病率约2.4%～65%[4]，我国学者相关报道中[5]，脑梗死患者肺部感染发生率20%～50%不等，不仅影响神经功能恢复，还引起多器官功能衰竭、提高病死率。 现代药理学研究证实[6]，针灸可通过抑制神经炎症、改善微循环等有效改善脑梗死运动、认知以及吞咽障碍后遗症。并随着中医整体理念的发展，针灸治疗在脑梗死肺炎中也展现出独特治疗价值。相关证据表明[7]，针灸刺激特定穴位可有效改善患者免疫功能，减轻肺部炎症症状。我国为针灸应用大国，约60%的脑梗死患者接受过针灸治疗。尽管针灸在神经重症领域的应用日益广泛，但现有研究多基于西医临床指标，忽略针灸治疗参数的潜在价值，导致针灸治疗的脑梗死恢复期患者肺部感染的预测受限[8]。 本研究首次聚焦于针灸治疗的脑梗死患者这一群体，探究此类人群肺部感染现状及其危险因素，旨在识别针灸干预下的脑梗死患者肺部感染高风险人群，同时基于针灸相关参数优化临床针灸治疗方案，为针灸治疗防治肺部感染提供更具临床转化价值的工具。 对象与方法 研究对象 本研究已通过本院伦理委员会审批（伦理审批号：2021-zj-24）。样本量计算根据logistic回归样本量的EPV（events per variable）原则，EPV=10，最终共纳入研究因素9个，故需要肺部感染患者至少90例，参考李宏[9]文献中肺部感染发生率29.09%，总样本量90÷0.29≈310例。为增加结果稳健性，综合考虑后，最终纳入2022年1月—2024年1月期间在院内治疗的350例脑梗死患者进入研究，将其作为建模集。按照建模集与验证集7∶3比例，同时选择2024年2月—2024年12月期间在院内治疗的150例脑梗死患者作为验证集。纳入标准：（1）符合脑梗死诊断标准[10]，为恢复期；（2）耐受针灸治疗，治疗期间无中断；（3）年龄18～80岁；（4）具备完整临床资料。排除标准：（1）针灸治疗前已合并肺部感染；（2）合并恶性肿瘤或血液病；（3）合并严重脏器功能不全；（4）针灸治疗中断。 诊断标准 结局指标为脑梗死患者1个月内是否发生肺部感染，以患者首次接受针灸治疗的时间点作为观察起点，持续观察针灸干预后的1个月。肺部感染诊断基于临床症状、血常规检查及影像学检查，发病7d内符合以下标准中的3项即可诊断：（1）新发咳嗽、咳痰，或原有症状加重；（2）痰培养检出致病菌；（3）双肺存在不同程度肺实质体征，和（或）伴干湿啰音；（4）白细胞计数升高且体温≥37.5 ℃；（5）影像学检查表现肺部感染征象。 研究方法 搜集患者资料，包括病原菌分布情况、性别、年龄、体质量指数（body mass index, BMI）、高血压、糖尿病、高血脂、冠心病、吸烟、饮酒；病程、梗死范围、梗死部位、吞咽功能障碍〔进食评估问卷调查工具-10（eating assessment tool-10, EAT-10）〕、侵入性操作（气管插管、气管切开等）；美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表（national institute of health stroke scale, NIHSS）评分[11]、格拉斯哥昏迷量表（glasgow coma scale, GCS）评分[12]；C反应蛋白（c-reactive protein, CRP）、空腹血糖、白蛋白、前白蛋白、白细胞计数和血红蛋白；中医证型、行针手法、留针时间、治疗频率、针灸疗程、针灸介入时间、穴位选择。实验室指标及相关评分均在首次接受针灸治疗时检测或评估，本研究纳入的针灸治疗方案以通督调神针刺为主，根据患者病情辨证配合项针、夹脊针、腹针等，治疗周期不低于7 d。 统计学方法 SPSS26.0分析数据，计量资料进行正态性检验，符合正态分布的以表示，组间比较采用t检验；不符合正态分布则表示为中位数（P25，P75），组间比较采用Manne Whitney U检验；计数资料表示为例数（%），组间比较采用χ2检验。使用R语言中glment包进行LASSO回归筛选重要变量，基于logistic多因素向后逐步回归法分析结果建立预测模型，rms包构建列线图并绘制受试者工作特征（receiver operator characteristic, ROC）曲线，曲线下面积（area under the curve, AUC）评估区分度，绘制校准曲线评价校准度，决策分析曲线（decision curve analysis, DCA）评价临床收益。P<0.05表示有统计学意义。 结果 肺部感染患者病原菌分布情况 建模集男性250例，女性100例，年龄（64.68±11.56）岁，BMI（22.54±2.18） kg/m2；验证集男性116例，女性34例，年龄（66.25±11.76）岁，BMI（22.54±2.16） kg/m2，两组在性别、年龄及BMI资料分布中差异无统计学意义（P>0.05）。肺部感染率为26.

title: Lesion-specific EEG signatures in stroke: a multi-scale framework integrating oscillations, connectivity, and asymmetry for machine learning decoding
creator: Wanting Liu, Conghui Wei, Yajing Lan, Xumiao Peng, Chenyuan Zhai, Zhen Liang, Li Zhang, Yan Gong, Gan Huang
description: BackgroundLesion location is a major source of post-stroke neurophysiological heterogeneity, yet most electroencephalography (EEG) studies analyze patients as a single group, limiting lesion-specific biomarkers and translation. We proposed a lesion-centric, multi-scale EEG framework integrating local oscillations, inter-regional connectivity, and hemispheric asymmetry with machine learning to characterize and decode basal ganglia (P1), fronto-temporal/centrum semiovale (P2), and brainstem (P3) lesions.

title: Evaluating the Impact of “On the Spot”: A Remote Pharmacy Hypertension Consult Service
creator: Briana Bethune, Jamie Coates, Naomi Yates
description: IntroductionPharmacist intervention can improve blood pressure (BP) control during scheduled pharmacy appointments; however, remote pharmacist impact during in-person nurse visits remains unclear. This study evaluated whether real-time remote consultations with clinical pharmacy specialists (CPSs) during nurse visits improve BP outcomes for patients.

title: 腹部手术患者慢性术后疼痛发生的神经心理危险因素分析
creator: 艳军 黄, 卫民 于, 杰 宁, 淑媛 王, 晓焕 李, 利朋 孙
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的分析腹部手术患者慢性术后疼痛（chronic postoperative pain, CPSP）的发生情况及神经心理危险因素。方法选取2023年1月—2025年1月本院行腹部手术的102例患者为研究对象，收集患者一般人口学资料及手术相关资料；术后3个月通过门诊随访或电话随访，采用疼痛数字评分法（numerical rating scale, NRS）评估CPSP发生情况，同时采用简易精神状态检查表（Mini-Mental State Examination, MMSE）、焦虑自评量表（Self-Rating Anxiety Scale, SAS）、抑郁自评量表（Self-Rating Depression Scale, SDS）及疼痛灾难化量表（Pain Catastrophizing Scale, PCS）评估患者神经心理状态。采用单因素和多因素logistic回归分析筛选CPSP的独立影响因素。结果102例患者中，术后3个月CPSP发生率为31.37%（32例）。CPSP组和非CPSP组在年龄、手术时长、术后住院天数、SDS、PCS方面差异有统计学意义（P<0.05）；多因素logistic回归分析显示年龄〔比值比（odds ratio, OR）=1.336，95%置信区间（confidence interval, CI）：1.046～1.710〕、术后住院天数（OR=0.495，95%CI：0.296～0.829）及PCS（OR=2.437，95%CI：1.137～5.224）为腹部手术患者术后3个月发生CPSP的独立影像因素（P<0.05）。结论年龄和PCS是腹部手术患者发生CPSP的危险因素，术后住院天数是保护因素。临床应针对高风险人群实施术前筛查、心理干预及疼痛管理，以降低CPSP发生率。 大型腹部手术涵盖多种外科术式，且患者群体存在高度异质性，因此术后疼痛程度与镇痛需求差异显著，镇痛策略需综合考量患者个体因素及手术特点[1]。术后疼痛是组织损伤引发的一种生理性保护反应，通常随手术部位的愈合而逐渐消退[2]。然而，部分患者的疼痛可能在术后长期持续存在。慢性术后疼痛（chronic postoperative pain, CPSP）定义为术后持续至少3至6个月的疼痛，其报告发生率介于10%至50%之间，正日益被视为常规手术后常见的后遗症[3]。术后疼痛程度及其带来的困扰，与并发症发生率的上升、功能恢复的延迟以及生活质量的下降密切相关[1]。CPSP不仅引起患者躯体不适，还可能诱发焦虑、抑郁等心理问题，降低睡眠质量及日常生活能力，甚至导致长期劳动力丧失、难以回归社会，从而给患者家庭及社会医疗资源带来沉重负担[4]。 CPSP的发生具有广泛的手术类型关联性，几乎所有类型的外科手术均存在诱发CPSP的可能。在各类外科手术相关的CPSP研究领域中，截肢手术、开颅手术、胸部手术、乳腺切除手术、腹股沟疝手术、剖宫产手术、胆囊切除术及膝关节置换手术，是目前学界关注度最高、数据积累最为丰富的CPSP相关手术类型[5]。研究表明，慢性疼痛的病因基于生物-心理-社会模型，因此身体、心理及社会因素均与CPSP的发展有关[6]。术前疼痛、术后重度急性疼痛、麻醉方式及手术方式等生物医学因素已得到广泛研究，而对疼痛认知、情绪状态、睡眠质量等神经心理因素的系统分析仍相对较少[7]。近年来，疼痛心理学研究提示，个体对疼痛的负性认知及情绪障碍可通过调节中枢神经系统的痛觉调制通路，加重疼痛感知并延长疼痛持续时间[8]。基于此，本研究通过分析CPSP的发生情况，重点探讨神经心理因素对CPSP发生的影响，旨在为临床制定生理-心理一体化的干预策略提供实证依据。 资料与方法 样本量计算 本研究为前瞻性观察性研究，主要结局指标为术后3个月CPSP发生率。参考国内外文献报道，腹部手术后CPSP发生率约为10%～50%，取预期发生率为30%。设定容许误差为8%，置信水平为95%，采用单样本率估算公式，计算得样本量为126 例。考虑20%的失访、排除及拒绝参与率，需纳入158 例。本研究采用随机抽样方法，从509例初步评估患者中随机抽取190例，经筛选、排除及失访后，最终纳入102例分析。主要分析的事后效能计算显示，在双侧α=0.05水平下，检验效能超过80%，当前样本量仍可满足主要研究目的。 研究对象 本研究经郑州大学第一附属医院医学伦理委员会审核批准（伦理批号：2025-ky-0311）。选取2023年1月—2025年1月于本院行腹部手术的患者102例。纳入标准：①>18岁；②择期腹部手术（包括胃肠手术、肝胆手术、胰腺手术、妇科腹部手术等）；③病例资料完整；④意识清楚，能完成神经心理量表评估；④自愿参与本研究并签署知情同意书。排除标准：①术前存在慢性疼痛史或神经病理性疼痛；②存在严重精神疾病（精神分裂症、双相障碍、分裂情感性障碍、精神发育迟滞、急性应激障碍伴严重功能缺损等）及认知障碍；③合并严重器官功能衰竭（终末期心、肝、肾、呼吸功能衰竭）、恶性肿瘤晚期、严重凝血功能障碍、自身免疫性疾病活动期等可能影响术后恢复及疼痛评估的重大躯体疾病；④术后出现严重并发症（吻合口瘘、感染）；⑤随访期间失访（如电话无法联系、拒绝继续参与）；⑥妊娠期或哺乳期女性。 CPSP诊断标准参照国际疼痛研究协会（IASP）针对《国际疾病分类》第11版（ICD-11）[9]提出的修订意见进行界定，具体标准如下：疼痛需与手术直接相关且疼痛部位局限于手术区域及其邻近部位，疼痛数字评分法（numerical rating scale, NRS）评分≥1分；疼痛持续时间需满足组织损伤已完全愈合（术后时间满3个月）后仍持续存在；排除由其他明确病因所致的疼痛；排除术前已存在的慢性疼痛状态。研究对象纳入流程见图1。 Flowchart of participant enrollment 研究对象纳入流程图 资料收集 分别于术前1 d、术后3个月及术后6个月进行资料收集。术前1 d收集一般人口学资料及手术相关资料，完成神经心理量表评估；术后3个月通过门诊随访或电话随访，评估CPSP发生情况及疼痛特征并完成神经心理量表评估；术后6个月通过门诊随访或电话随访，评估CPSP发生情况。调查员均为外科主治医师或护理师，经统一培训掌握量表使用方法及访谈技巧；量表填写时，调查员现场指导，确保患者理解条目含义；资料收集后，由2名研究员独立核对数据，发现缺失或矛盾时及时联系患者补充确认。本研究术后6个月CPSP仅23例，为减少统计效能不足及偏倚风险，并基于IASP《国际疾病分类》第11版（ICD-11）将术后3个月定为结局指标（术后3个月作为界定急性疼痛向慢性疼痛转化的核心节点，为CPSP诊断及同类研究的国际通用时点，以此为结局指标可保证研究的规范性与可比性，且该时点也是临床识别CPSP高危人群、实施早期干预的关键窗口期，研究结论更具临床实践价值）。 一般人口学资料问卷：自行设计，包括年龄、性别、体质量指数（body mass index, BMI）、文化程度、职业、既往手术史、糖尿病史、冠心病史、高血压史、吸烟史、饮酒史、居住地。 手术相关资料：从电子病历系统提取，包括手术类型、手术方式、手术时长、切口部位术中出血量、术后切口感染、术后住院天数等。 疼痛评估及神经心理量表评估 数字评分法 NRS[10]用于评估疼痛程度，量表范围0～10分，0分代表无痛，10分代表最剧烈疼痛；NRS<4分为轻度疼痛，NRS≥4分为中重度疼痛[4]。同时记录疼痛部位（切口周围/腹部其他部位/牵涉痛）、疼痛性质（钝痛/胀痛/刺痛/烧灼感）。 简易精神状态检查表 采用简易精神状态检查表（Mini-Mental State Examination, MMSE）[11]评估患者的整体认知功能，该量表共30个条目，总分0～30分，分值越低，认知能力越差。 心理情绪状态评估 焦虑自评量表（Self-Rating Anxiety Scale, SAS）及抑郁自评量表（Self-Rating Depression Scale, SDS）为自我评价量表[12]。SAS共20个条目，采用1～4级评分，满分100分，<50分为正常，≥50分为焦虑。SDS共20个条目，1～4级评分，<53分为正常，≥53分为抑郁。 疼痛灾难化量表[13] 采用疼痛灾难化量表（Pain Catastrophizing Scale, PCS）对疼痛的消极认知及情感应对策略进行评估。该量表共13个条目，0～4级评分，总分0～52分，≥30分为存在明显疼痛灾难化。 统计学方法 采用SPSS 25.0软件进行数据分析。符合正态分布的计量资料以\begin{document}$ \overline{x}\pm s title: Ultrasound assessment of muscle atrophy and its association with functional outcomes in critically ill patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
creator: Chen-Chun Lin, Yi-Jia Lin, Chi-Tsung Chen, Hsiao-Min Chou, Wei-Chun Hsu
description: BackgroundCritically ill patients experience rapid skeletal muscle wasting due to immobility and systemic inflammation. Traditional imaging modalities—including computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, and dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry—can accurately quantify muscle mass but are impractical for monitoring critically ill patients because of cost, radiation, and logistical constraints.

title: Advancement in Scaffold-Based 3D Cell Culture Models for Osteosarcoma Drug Screening
creator: Ponnamma Mandeda Madaiah, Rudra Nath Ghosh, Pramod K Namboothiri, Mathew Peter
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Osteosarcoma (OS), an extremely aggressive bone cancer that primarily occurs in children and teenagers, continues to pose critical clinical challenges due to its high propensity for metastasis, resistance to conventional therapies, and lack of specific biomarkers for early detection. Despite advances in surgical techniques and chemotherapeutic regimens, patient outcomes remain suboptimal, predominantly because conventional two-dimensional (2D) cell culture systems do not accurately mimic the intricate tumor microenvironment (TME), which often results in limited success when translating preclinical results to clinical success.

title: AI in peer review: can artificial intelligence be an ally in reducing gender and geographical gaps in peer review? A randomized trial
creator: André L Teixeira
description: BackgroundGender and geographical disparities have been widely reported in the peer-review process of biomedical journals. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly transforming the publishing system; however, its potential to identify suitable reviewers, and whether it might reduce, replicate or reinforce existing biases in peer review has never been comprehensively investigated.

title: Self-perceived attractiveness of labiomental angles in Taiwanese and Caucasian males: A comparative study before and after orthodontic education among dental students
creator: Shih-Chieh Chen, Chun-Ming Chen, Szu-Ting Chou, Fu-Jia Syu, HisHam Mamoon, Yu-Chuan Tseng
description: Background/purposeThe labiomental angle plays a critical role in determining facial profile attractiveness, with aesthetic preferences influenced by ethnic background. This study investigated how variations in the labiomental angle influenced facial profile aesthetics and examined changes in dental students’ understanding of facial aesthetics before and after orthodontic lectures.Materials and methodsOne adult Taiwanese male and one adult Caucasian male were selected.

title: DNA甲基化调控衰老相关骨代谢失衡的机制与干预研究进展
creator: Tailin He, Jie Li, Yifang Mei, Guozhi Xiao
description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 衰老可诱发骨质疏松等增龄性骨病。DNA甲基化是一类核心表观遗传调控方式，能够通过表观遗传层面的基因表达调控，参与衰老诱导骨代谢失衡的病理过程。它以S-腺苷甲硫氨酸作为甲基供体，随着年龄增长，呈现出基因组重复区域低甲基化以及骨代谢关键基因启动子CpG岛异常甲基化的特征。基于这些特征构建的“表观遗传时钟”能够高精度地预测个体的生理年龄。在骨代谢中，DNA甲基化通过靶向核心因子打破成骨—破骨平衡。此类异常由衰老相关炎症和氧化应激驱动，同时骨质流失会反馈加重表观遗传紊乱，形成恶性循环。靶向干预策略在应对骨代谢相关问题方面已展现出显著潜力。低剂量的DNA甲基转移酶抑制剂能够通过调节相关酶活性，有效改善骨代谢的紊乱状态；叶酸、钴胺素等营养素可通过优化一碳代谢途径，维持DNA甲基化的稳态平衡；而CRISPR/dCas技术凭借其高精度特性，在细胞和动物水平可实现对特定基因位点的精准调控，进而影响骨代谢过程。然而，当前现有的靶向干预策略仍面临诸多挑战，如脱靶效应、递送效率低下等问题，需要进一步深入探究相关作用机制，优化现有的干预手段，从而推动这些策略向骨质疏松的临床防治领域有效转化。Keywords: DNA甲基化, 骨质疏松症, 衰老, 成骨细胞, 破骨细胞, 表观遗传时钟

随着全球人口老龄化进程的持续加速，衰老进程及其诱发的退行性疾病已演变为全球性公共卫生挑战。在诸多衰老相关退行性疾病中，以骨质疏松症、骨关节炎为代表的骨骼系统疾病，因其高发病率、致残性以及对生活质量的严重影响，备受关注[1]。过往大部分研究发现，骨骼的衰老是基因遗传程序与时间依赖性损伤累积共同作用的结果[2]。然而，传统的遗传学理论难以完全解释骨骼衰老进程中表现的异质性、可塑性以及对环境因素（如营养、力学负荷）的高度敏感性。近年来，表观遗传学机制的深入研究，为我们理解衰老及骨代谢稳态失衡提供了全新的视角。

表观遗传调控机制作为不涉及DNA碱基序列改变的基因表达调控范式，通过DNA甲基化、组蛋白修饰等化学修饰途径，引发可遗传的表观遗传表型变异[3]。在众多表观遗传修饰中，DNA甲基化作为目前最稳定、研究最充分的机制之一，被视为细胞的“分子记忆”和“衰老时钟”的核心载体。它通过在CpG二核苷酸岛的胞嘧啶上添加甲基，动态调控染色质结构、基因组稳定性及靶基因的转录活性[4]。已有研究表明，衰老伴随着全基因组甲基化水平的普遍降低（低甲基化）与特定基因启动子区（如肿瘤抑制基因）的异常高甲基化，这种“表观遗传漂变”或“表观遗传紊乱”是细胞功能衰退和细胞微环境稳态失衡的重要驱动力[5]。

在骨骼稳态维持体系中，包括间充质干细胞、成骨细胞、破骨细胞及软骨细胞在内的所有骨组织相关细胞，其增殖分化、功能维持及细胞间通讯等生物学行为均受到精密的表观遗传调控网络制约。DNA甲基化模式的增龄性改变，已被证实可直接影响成骨分化潜能、骨骼干细胞衰老、骨基质合成与矿化，以及炎症反应等关键生理病理过程，从而参与骨质疏松、骨关节炎等疾病的发病[6]。以衰老骨组织为例，表观遗传修饰异常显著影响骨代谢平衡。具体表现为：成骨相关基因启动子区域呈现过度甲基化修饰，这种表观遗传沉默效应直接抑制成骨细胞分化关键因子的转录活性，进而导致骨形成功能进行性衰退；与此同时，炎症相关因子编码基因的低甲基化状态则通过增强基因可及性，促进核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa-B，NF-κB）等炎症信号通路的持续激活，最终形成“炎性衰老”的恶性循环，加速骨吸收进程[7]。因此，DNA甲基化不仅是连接衰老过程与骨骼表型的分子桥梁，更可能成为干预骨骼衰老、防治相关疾病的潜在新靶点。

本综述旨在系统阐述衰老过程中DNA甲基化动态变化的基本规律，深入解析其在主要衰老相关骨疾病发生发展中的特异性调控作用与分子机制，并展望以靶向DNA甲基化修饰为核心的表观遗传治疗策略在骨骼衰老干预中的转化潜力与挑战。通过整合当前最新研究进展，我们期望为深入理解骨骼衰老的生物学本质，以及开发新型诊断与治疗手段提供理论依据。

衰老与甲基化

衰老是机体在整个生命周期中随时间进展发生的生理功能退行过程，其核心特征为细胞损伤修复能力减弱导致的分子层面损伤积累[8]，同时显著升高骨质疏松、骨性关节炎、心脑血管疾病及神经退行性疾病等增龄性疾病的发病风险[9-10]。因此，揭示衰老的分子调控网络并构建精准干预体系，对提升老年人群健康寿命具有重要战略价值。近年来，衰老生物学领域已明确多个核心衰老标志物，其中表观遗传改变作为关键标志物之一，为衰老机制提供了重要理论支撑[11-12]。DNA甲基化、组蛋白动态修饰、染色质三维结构重塑、RNA化学修饰及非编码RNA介导的调控网络等不涉及DNA序列改变的基因表达调控机制构成衰老相关表观遗传时钟的重要分子基础。这些修饰模式的时空动态变化，已成为解析衰老速率异质性的关键切入点[3]。

作为最经典的表观遗传标记，DNA甲基化通过DNA甲基转移酶（DNA methyltransferases，DNMT）催化的生化反应实现：以S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（s-adenosylmethionine，SAM）为甲基供体，在CpG二核苷酸位点的胞嘧啶第5位碳原子上共价结合甲基基团，形成5-甲基胞嘧啶[13]。根据功能特性，DNMTs可分为两大亚类：DNMT1通过识别半甲基化DNA底物，在DNA复制过程中忠实复制亲代链的甲基化图谱，确保表观遗传信息的垂直传递； DNMT3a和DNMT3b则主要催化未甲基化CpG位点的新甲基化修饰（从头甲基化）[14]。DNA去甲基化过程主要通过两条途径实现：（1）被动途径：核因子结合甲基化DNA区域，阻碍DNMT1对DNA半甲基化位点的识别与维持，导致甲基化修饰在细胞分裂过程中逐渐稀释丢失；（2）主动途径：由DNA去甲基化酶10-11易位（ten-eleven translocation，TET）蛋白家族等去甲基化酶介导，通过氧化、切除等一系列复杂生化反应直接移除甲基基团[15-16]。DNA甲基化对基因转录的抑制作用主要通过直接阻断与间接招募两种模式实现：（1）转录因子结合位点屏蔽机制：5-甲基胞嘧啶的引入可立体位阻甲基化敏感型转录因子（如E2F、CREB、AP2家族成员）与靶基因启动子区CpG岛的特异性结合，直接阻断转录起始复合物的组装；（2）表观遗传复合物招募机制：甲基化CpG结合结构域蛋白（MBD家族，包括MeCP2、MBD1-4等）通过高亲和力识别5-甲基胞嘧啶修饰位点，作为分子支架定向招募组蛋白去乙酰化酶、组蛋白甲基转移酶等染色质修饰酶，形成抑制性表观遗传复合物，诱导染色质从松散转录活性状态转变为紧密异染色质构象，物理性阻遏RNA聚合酶Ⅱ进程延伸[17]。

DNA甲基化可作为评估人类衰老进程及衰老速率差异的核心表观遗传标志物。研究人员基于甲基化修饰特征开发了多种“表观遗传时钟”，能够独立于实际年龄高精度预测人类受试者的生理年龄[18]。跨物种比较研究显示，通过检测六种哺乳动物血液和皮肤样本中保守的年龄相关CpG位点甲基化率，发现基因组整体CpG位点甲基化率与物种最长寿命呈显著负相关，提示DNA甲基化调控衰老的机制具有进化保守性，均存在类似的表观遗传时钟调控网络[19]。目前已经建立的经典的表观遗传时钟包括：Horvath Clock（基于数万个人类组织样本开发的多组织生理年龄评估工具）[20]、Hannum Clock（基于单组织DNA甲基化特征的年龄估计模型）[21]、DNAm PhenoAge（结合血压、血脂、葡萄糖等临床生物标志物的生理年龄评估方法）[22]，以及GrimAge Clock（由7个基于DNA甲基化调控的血浆蛋白标志物和吸烟相关死亡率数据构成的衰老预测模型）（图1）[23-24]。

title: Marfanoid phenotype with intellectual disability associated with NKAP mutation: a case report
creator: Alla N. Semyachkina, Ekaterina A. Nikolaeva, Daria Iu. Gritsevskaya, Victoria Yu. Voinova, Rabiat G. Kuramagomedova, Sergei V. Bochenkov, Olga S. Groznova, Mariia A. Parfenenko, Olga V. Kalashnikova, Evgenia A. Isupova
description: BackgroundHackman–Di Donato syndrome (Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man no. 301,039), caused by mutations of the NKAP gene, located in Xq24, is a rare genetic disorder characterized by a Marfanoid phenotype, intellectual disability, and abnormalities of the musculoskeletal system. This condition has only been described in ten patients and two fetuses, who were identified owing to severe heart defects.

title: CRISPR/Cas系统在临床耐药菌快速检测中的应用研究进展
creator: 珍 宋, 惠 李, 亚楠 赵, 敏 李
description: 抗菌药物的滥用使得抗微生物药物耐药性成为危害全球公共健康的重大威胁之一，如何高效地实现耐药菌和耐药基因的便捷快速检测是控制感染扩散、维护人类健康的关键举措。然而传统的检测方法（如分离培养、PCR等）在检测速度、成本效益、便捷性等方面存在明显局限，越来越难以满足当下的临床检测需求。在此背景下，CRISPR/Cas系统作为一种新兴的分子诊断技术，为该领域提供了创新解决方案。本文详细介绍CRISPR/Cas系统发展现状及其在临床耐药菌快速检测中应用研究进展，系统阐述了多种基于CRISPR/Cas系统研发的检测平台（如SHERLOCK、DETECTR、HOLMES等）的工作原理和效能，并重点突出CRISPR/Cas系统在检测领域的灵敏、特异、高效、实时、便携和低成本等优势。此外，本文还探讨了CRISPR/Cas系统面临的挑战，包括对临床样本直接检测、多重检测、检测成本、临床验证和标准化等问题。最后，本文展望了未来的发展方向，强调聚焦技术创新与临床转化使得CRISPR/Cas系统成为耐药菌防控的高效工具。 抗微生物药物耐药性（antimicrobial resistance，AMR）是全球人类健康、现代医学和社会可持续发展所面临的最大威胁之一[1-2]，由耐药菌引起的感染会导致严重的全球疾病负担。有研究显示，2019年全球估计有495万人的死亡与AMR相关，其中因AMR直接死亡的高达127万人[3]。WHO发布的《2024年细菌类重点病原体目录》里就包含了耐碳青霉烯酶的肺炎克雷伯菌、耐第三代头孢菌素大肠埃希菌、耐碳青霉烯酶的鲍曼不动杆菌、耐利福平的结核分枝杆菌等多种临床常见耐药菌[4]。如何应对AMR带来的挑战是当今医疗卫生部门需要面对的一大难题。 目前应对AMR的主要举措有健全感染防控体系、及时诊断治疗、监测流行趋势和研发新的抗菌药物、诊断方法和预防工具[4]。准确快速检测出耐药菌是感染防控的第一步，也是控制AMR扩散的关键步骤，因为这意味着医生可以更快地锁定合适的抗菌药物，从而改善患者的治疗结果，降低药物不良事件的风险，减少病原体传播的可能性[5]。现如今在临床微生物实验室普遍用于耐药菌检测的实验方法有：传统的手工药敏检测（K-B纸片扩散法、肉汤稀释法等）、全自动药敏检测系统、质谱检测、基于聚合酶链式反应（polymerase chain reaction, PCR）的分子检测技术等。传统的手工法和全自动药敏检测系统往往依赖于病原菌的培养，耗时至少36 h甚至更长，而且药物种类不够全面；质谱检测耗时短，但只能检测特定的酶(如β -内酰胺酶或碳青霉烯酶等），检测范围较狭窄[6]；基于PCR的分子检测技术虽然检测速度快，耗时1～4 h不等，但设备的购买和维护依然昂贵[5]。 规律成簇间隔短回文序列 （clustered regularly interspaced short-palindromic repeat, CRISPR）/CRISPR相关核酸内切酶 （CRISPR-associated endonuclease, Cas） 系统作为一种基因编辑技术，还具有DNase/RNase特性，在病原体分子诊断方面展现出卓越的灵敏度、特异性、快速性和便携性[7]，这类方法有望克服传统耐药菌检测方法的局限，助力耐药菌的快速检测。 本文主要介绍了CRISPR/Cas系统的功能和检测效用，特别是其在耐药菌和耐药基因检测中的重要应用，包括目前已开发的主要检测平台、检测优势、挑战和未来方向，为控制和减少细菌耐药性的扩大提供了参考。 CRISPR/Cas系统简述 CRISPR序列是一组存在于细菌和古细菌中的适应性免疫机制，其免疫过程经历适应、表达和干扰三个阶段。在适应阶段通过摄取来自入侵噬菌体的一段前间隔序列（protospacer）整合到自身的CRISPR 序列中形成间隔序列（spacer），获取“免疫记忆”；当再次遇到携带同源间隔序列的噬菌体时进入表达阶段，转录CRISPR阵列并加工为成熟的CRISPR RNA（crRNA），产生特异性靶向噬菌体外源DNA的向导RNA（guide RNA, gRNA）；在干扰阶段，gRNA引导Cas蛋白识别并切割互补的外源噬菌体DNA，发挥免疫应答作用[8]。Jinek等[9]由此获得灵感，于2012年首次实现了 CRISPR/Cas9 系统的体外结合并切割靶标DNA的特定位点；张峰团队[10]在2013年首次将CRISPR/Cas9系统应用于小鼠和人类细胞，完成体内基因组位点的精确切割，从而为CRISPR /Cas用于核酸检测奠定了机制基础。利用人工设计的crRNA序列取代细菌捕获的外源DNA片段，使其与目标病原体序列（靶标）完全互补，Cas蛋白在crRNA引导下识别并切割靶标成为将CRISPR/Cas系统研发为分子诊断工具的突破口。 CRISPR/Cas系统的结构由CRISPR基因座（DNA序列）和Cas蛋白共同组成，前者包含位于CRISPR阵列上游的前导序列、在CRISPR阵列中规律间隔排列的重复序列和间隔序列，后者包含核心相应蛋白及辅助蛋白。CRISPR/Cas 系统根据其Cas蛋白的组成差异和效应器中蛋白组合序列可分为两类，第一类为Ⅰ、Ⅲ、Ⅳ型，第二类为Ⅱ、Ⅴ、Ⅵ型，两者的区别在于前者的效应器是由多个Cas蛋白组成的复合体，后者效应器是单个有多结合域的Cas 蛋白，目前在耐药菌检测方面广泛应用的Cas9（Ⅱ型）、Cas12（Ⅴ型）、Cas13（Ⅵ型）、Cas14（V型）都属于第二类[11-12]。 CRISPR/Cas系统在耐药菌检测中的基本原理 CRISPR/Cas系统在分子诊断中的应用主要基于其核酸靶向识别和切割能力。不同类型的Cas效应蛋白具有不同的核酸切割活性。表1列出了不同CRISPR/Cas系统在分子诊断应用中的重要结构和特点。 表 1Structures and features of different CRISPR-Cas system不同CRISPR/Cas系统的结构和特点Cas title: 重症肺炎合并支原体感染患儿预后情况及影响因素分析
creator: Chen Zhou, Yan Yi, Yun Tan, Xueping Jiang, Yangcan Ming
description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的探究重症肺炎合并支原体感染患儿血清淀粉样蛋白A、凝血指标水平变化及其与患儿预后的关系。方法回顾性选取我院于2022年7月—2024年12月儿科收治的300例重症肺炎患儿为研究对象。以患儿是否发生支原体感染为分组依据，将其分为非支原体感染组（n=180）和合并支原体感染组（n=120），根据重症肺炎合并支原体感染患儿预后分为预后良好组（n=85）和预后不良组（n=35），收集所有患儿的一般资料。通过Logistic回归分析确定年龄、血清淀粉样蛋白A（serum amyloid-A, SAA）、纤维蛋白原（fibrinogen, Fib）、肺部超声（lung ultrasound, LUS）评分等是否为影响患儿预后的影响因素，并利用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估其诊断效能。结果合并支原体感染组患儿血清SAA、Fib指标水平以及LUS评分均高于非支原体感染组（均P<0.05）。Spearman分析显示，重症肺炎患儿血清SAA、Fib指标水平和LUS评分与其发生支原体感染、支原体感染后预后不良均呈正相关关系（均P<0.05），ROC曲线显示三者评分联合预测重症肺炎患儿发生支原体感染的AUC为0.928〔95%置信区间（confidence interval, CI）：0.899～0.957〕。多因素Logistic分析发现：年龄〔比值比（OR）=0.053，95%CI：0.003~0.997〕、SAA（OR=1.045，95%CI：1.003~1.085）、Fib（OR=1.757，95%CI：1.378~8.158）、LUS评分（OR=3.538，95%CI：1.480~8.457）是合并支原体感染患儿预后的影响因素（P<0.05）。ROC曲线发现，年龄、SAA、Fib以及LUS评分预测合并支原体感染患儿预后的AUC分别为0.837（95%CI：0.764～0.856）、0.792（95%CI：0.701～0.884）、0.755（95%CI：0.655～0.909）、0.917（95%CI：0.828～1.000），四者联合的AUC为0.997（95%CI：0.992～1.000）。结论年龄、SAA、Fib、LUS评分可作为重症肺炎合并支原体感染患儿预后的诊断指标，其中以联合诊断的效能最高，有助于临床提高对该疾病预后的诊断。Keywords: 重症肺炎, 支原体感染, 小儿, 血清淀粉样蛋白A, 凝血指标, 预后 重症肺炎是儿童呼吸系统感染性疾病中的危急重症，具有起病急、进展快、并发症多等特点，其高致死率及长期后遗症已成为全球儿童健康的重要威胁[1]。近年来随着病原学检测技术的发展，肺炎支原体作为社区获得性肺炎重要病原体，在重症肺炎中的检出率不断攀升[2]。既往研究显示[3]，儿童社区获得性肺炎中，肺炎支原体感染占比 10%~40%，且学龄期和青少年与成年人相比更为高发。肺炎支原体感染不仅可直接导致肺组织损伤，还可通过免疫介导的炎症反应、凝血功能异常等机制加剧病情进展，甚至诱发多器官功能障碍综合征，显著增加患儿的病死率和住院时间[4]。血清淀粉样蛋白A（serum amyloid-A, SAA）作为急性时相反应蛋白，感染、炎症或组织损伤时会快速升高，其敏感性显著高于传统炎症标志物[5]。研究表明[6]，SAA在肺炎支原体感染患儿中的早期即显著升高，且与病情严重程度密切相关，可能成为评估肺炎支原体感染疾病活动度的潜在生物标志物。此外，重症肺炎患儿常伴随凝血功能异常，表现为血小板减少、凝血酶原时间延长、纤维蛋白原（fibrinogen, Fib）水平波动及D-二聚体显著升高，提示微循环障碍及血栓形成风险增加[7]。凝血指标的异常不仅反映疾病严重程度，还可能通过“炎症-凝血”交互作用进一步加剧肺损伤及全身炎症反应，形成恶性循环。近年来，肺部超声因其无创、无辐射、可床旁实时动态监测等优势，在儿童重症肺炎的诊疗中应用日益广泛。肺部超声可直观评估肺实变、胸腔积液、间质综合征等病变特征，其"碎片征""支气管充气征"等特异性征象有助于判断肺组织受累程度及病情演变趋势。联合肺部超声影像学评估与血清学标志物检测，可为重症肺炎合并肺炎支原体感染患儿的病情分层与治疗决策提供多维度依据。 目前，关于重症肺炎合并支原体感染患儿中SAA与凝血指标的动态变化及其与预后的关联性研究尚不充分。现有研究多集中于单一指标或单一系统的评估，缺乏对炎症标志物与凝血功能协同作用的系统性分析。而SAA作为早期炎症标志物，其与凝血指标的联合检测可能为重症肺炎合并肺炎支原体感染患儿的病情分层、风险评估及预后预测提供更精准的依据。因此，本研究旨在揭示“炎症-凝血”交互作用在疾病进展中的作用机制，为临床早期干预及个体化治疗提供理论支持。 资料与方法 研究对象 回顾性选取我院于2022年7月—2024年12月儿科收治的重症肺炎患儿为研究对象，共300例。 本次研究经本院医学伦理委员会批准（批准号LL2025040127），所有患儿家属均签署知情同意书。 所有纳入对象均需符合以下纳入标准：①年龄7个月～14岁。②符合临床相关诊断标准[8]：a.呼吸心率异常：<1岁：呼吸频率>50 min－1，心率>150 min－1；1～5岁：呼吸频率>40 min－1，心率>140 min－1；伴或不伴动脉血压下降（收缩压<75 mmHg，1mmHg=0.133 kPa）、三凹征及发绀等。b.大环内酯类药物治疗无效：规范应用大环内酯类药物1周以上无效，腋温>38.5 ℃或肺部影像学无好转甚至进展，或持续发热时间>10 d。c.胸部影像学表现：大片状致密影，占据一个肺段或肺叶以上范围，可累及单叶或多叶病变。d.肺内并发症：出现严重低氧血症（PaO2<60 mmHg）或合并其他系统严重损害（中枢神经系统感染、心力衰竭、心肌炎、消化道出血、明显电解质/酸碱平衡紊乱等）。③支气管发育正常。④急性起病，伴发烧、呼吸道症状。⑤均进行了血清肺炎支原体（Mycoplasma pneumoniae, MP）-免疫球蛋白M（human immunoglobulin M, IgM）抗体检测。⑥胸部X线呈斑片状、片状浸润性阴影。 排除标准：①合并自身免疫性疾病；②合并恶性肿瘤；③合并呼吸系统疾病；④存在遗传性疾病史；⑤合并肺脓肿等相关肺部疾病；⑥存在既往免疫治疗的患儿。 脱落标准：因诸多因素影响而拒绝配合随访者。 剔除标准：处于同时参与其他试验研究状态的研究对象。 支原体感染判定标准：血清MP-IgM阳性或鼻咽分泌物MP-DNA阳性。以是否发生支原体感染为分组依据，将300例纳入对象分为非支原体感染组（n=180）和合并支原体感染组（n=120）。对合并支原体感染组患儿进行3个月的随访，按预后评估标准[9]，再将患儿分为预后不良组和预后良好组。 方法 采用医院电子病历和门诊系统获取患儿的基线资料，包括：一般资料：年龄、性别、病程、体质量指数、住院天数。实验室指标：在患儿入院后的24 h时间段内，采集其5 mL外周血样本，随后进行离心处理，以备后续检测。酶联免疫吸附法检测血清SAA指标水平；酶联免疫法检测Fib水平。 肺部超声（lung ultrasound, LUS）检查及评分标准 检查：使用 Philips-HD15 型超声诊断仪开展检查，学龄前儿童选用 10～13 MHz 的线性探头，年龄较大或肥胖儿童则采用 6～8 MHz 的凸探头，且所有检查均由同一位资深超声医师操作。检查期间患儿取坐位，并在入院后的 48 小时之内完成超声检查。以下几种情况，如胸膜线出现异常、B 线数量增多或融合、存在支气管充气征、伴有胸腔积液、出现肺实质性改变等，均提示超声表现异常。 标准：共计12个区域，总评分为0～60分。其中，（1）正常（N，0分）：肺呈现滑动征、出现A线，或是仅见零星分布的B线；（2）中度肺湿变（B1，3分）：融合B线；（3）重度肺湿变和/或轻度肺实变（B2，4分）：可见大片融合的B线，同时伴有少量碎片样征象或局部肺实变；（4）肺实变（B3，5分）：可见类似肝组织的实质结构并伴有支气管充气征，或存在肺实变且合并有胸腔积液。 统计学方法 应用SPSS26.0统计软件对所得数据进行分析，计数资料以例数表示，组间比较行χ2检验；计量资料采用表示，组间比较行t 检验；Spearman相关性检验血清SAA、Fib、LUS评分与重症肺炎患儿发生支原体感染及其预后之间的关系。基于计算机自动筛选影响因素，采用Logistic单因素和多因素分析重症肺炎合并支原体感染患者预后的影响因素。通过受试者工作特征（receiver operating characteristic, ROC）曲线下面积（area under the curve, AUC）评价患儿预后不良的诊断价值。P<0.05为差异有统计学意义。 结果 两组临床资料对比 合并支原体感染组患儿血清SAA、Fib指标水平以及LUS评分均高于非支原体感染组（均P<0.05）。见表1。 表 1Comparison of clinical characteristics
